exposure: Induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation
induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation
outcome: Maternal adverse outcomes (composite: admission to the intensive care unit, transfusion, uterine rupture, or unplanned hysterectomy)
Neonatal adverse outcomes (composite: 5-minute Apgar score <5, assisted ventilation for >6 h, neonatal seizures, or neonatal mortality)
cohort: Individuals with one or two prior cesarean deliveries from the U.S. National Vital Statistics 2014-2018 period linked birth and infant death data
finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation in women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean was associated with fewer maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes compared to expectant management (delivery at 40-41 weeks gestation).
